facts.content: Prescribe Salbutamol (Ventolin) inhaler to use as needed.
facts.source_text: • Inhaled bronchodilator: Prescribe Salbutamol (Ventolin) inhaler PRN.

facts.content: Prescribe Clinol inhaler for maintenance therapy.
facts.source_text: • Inhaled corticosteroid: Prescribe Clinol inhaler for maintenance.

facts.content: Start a 5-day course of oral corticosteroids at a dose of 2 tablets in the morning.
facts.source_text: • Oral corticosteroids: Start 5-day course; 2 tablets in the morning.

facts.content: Provide a spacer device with instructions and education on its use, including priming then inhaling for 5–10 breaths.
facts.source_text: • Spacer device: Provide spacer with instructions; educate on use (prime, then inhale, 5–10 breaths).

facts.content: Advise patient to seek medical attention promptly if Ventolin is needed more often than every 3 hours or if symptoms worsen.
facts.source_text: • Safety/usage guidance: If Ventolin needed more than every 3 hours or symptoms worsen, seek medical attention promptly.

facts.content: Allow patient to self-certify for 7 days and rest as tolerated until improvement.
facts.source_text: • Activity/work: Self-certify for 7 days; rest as tolerated until improved.

facts.content: Provide education on possible steroid side effects including mood changes, blood sugar effects, rash, nausea, and headaches, and advise to read the label.
facts.source_text: • Education on steroids: Possible side effects (mood changes, blood sugar effects, rash, nausea, headaches); read label; generally well tolerated.

facts.content: Patient is instructed to seek care if there is deterioration or new concerning symptoms such as chest pain or lightheadedness.
facts.source_text: • Follow-up: Instruct to seek care if deterioration or new concerning symptoms (e.g., chest pain, lightheadedness).
